spec.rationale: Disclosure recipients are nested participant terms whose possessors remain explicit. The contextual party constructor permits a representative definition to be instantiated for the party acting as recipient, while descriptions and information definitions remain non-operative. Permissions may occur directly or as exceptions inside prohibitions. Authorization and purpose exceptions remain bounded exceptions rather than general disclosure permissions.

seeds.quote: (a) Subject to the restrictions set forth below in this Section 4, each Party may disclose the other Party’s Confidential Information to its directors, officers, employees, legal advisors, financial advisors and accountants, each bound by obligations of confidentiality consistent with this Agreement, who have a bona fide need to know (“Representatives”), but only to the extent necessary to carry out the Business Purpose.

WHEREAS the Parties recognize that in the course of their discussions to further the Business Purpose, it may become necessary for either NEW RIVER or SHIRE or both Parties to disclose Confidential Information (as defined below) to a Receiving Party, whether orally, in writing, graphically, electronically or by visual inspection of the premises of the Disclosing Party, and

The Receiving Party shall not disclose, allow access to, transmit or transfer the Confidential Information to any third party without the Disclosing Party’s prior written consent, provided however that the Receiving Party may disclose the Confidential Information to those of its directors, officers and employees ("Representatives") who have a need to know the Confidential Information for the Purpose provided that the Receiving Party shall ensure that such Representatives treat the Confidential Information as confidential and at all times in a manner consistent with this Agreement and the Receiving Party shall be liable for any loss or damage resulting from any Representative failing to do so.

update.rationale: 该更新修复了上游编译器遗漏的“受限内部披露许可”：当当前条款明确允许向接收方的雇员或承包商披露，并同时要求知悉必要性和书面保密约束时，组合器新增一个具有原条款支持的 permission，而不是把第三方禁令、原生答案或其他合同中的参与者直接搬入当前合同。两个独立读数分别确认接收者范围和累积保障条件；任何 unknown 都不会触发构造。现有上游根通过 keep_root 原样保留，因此返还、销毁及禁止留存能力不受影响。候选规则还包含仅构造雇员许可或仅构造承包商许可的欠泛化方案；TRAIN 中两个披露问题可以区分这些方案，而联合许可同时解释两项监督。
